verdict.rationale: cubic's memory-and-learning docs say you can reply to a review comment explaining what cubic should do differently, and it remembers for next time. Thumbs up/down reactions also help it calibrate useful feedback versus noise for your codebase, and it learns from direct feedback on its comments. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that rejected feedback actually stops recurring, and documentation of how learned memories are scoped, viewed or managed.
